statement.p: Find area of the region under the curve y = 4 x^3 - 2 and above the x-axis, for 2 \le x \le 5.

static.solution:
(Click on the graph for a larger version.)
The area we want is that above the x-axis and under the function, for 2 \le x \le 5. Thus we need to find \int_{2}^{5} (4 x^3 - 2) dx \approx 603. We can find the area in a number of ways, the easiest of which is to use a graphing calculator.
